subject: Cutover: PO receipt windows impacting recognized bookings
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sat, 08 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Cutover: PO receipt windows impacting recognized bookings

Team / Sarah —

Quick note as we head into Q3 close: ACME has signaled the contract is ready but their procurement timelines are uncertain. Based on prior cycles, their PO issuance and our ability to invoice may slip into the next quarter unless we get PO numbers and invoice permissions by mid-August. That timing will directly impact whether we can recognize these bookings in Q3.

Questions for finance + ops:
- What is the latest invoice date that still counts toward Q3 revenue (considering our month-end GL cutoffs)?
- If ACME issues a PO after the cutoff but requests retroactive billing, do we have a policy or precedence to recognize in Q3?

Action items I propose now:
1) Ask ACME to prioritize PO issuance by Tue Aug 18.
2) If PO arrives after Aug 18, move deal to "Commit - At Risk" and update commit in the forecast for Q4 impact.
3) Finance to confirm invoice lead time and any expedited billing options.

I'm attaching a short file showing ACME's historical PO lead times (billing_window_table.csv) for reference. Sarah — any insight on how quickly procurement can lock this down?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 08 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cutover: PO receipt windows impacting recognized bookings

Hi Marissa / Grace —

Thanks for the heads up. Internal procurement typically takes 7-10 business days after legal signs off to issue a PO. For this contract we're trying to expedite but I can't promise more than "best effort." I have routed this to our PO team; they said they can sometimes issue a preliminary PO/intent to allow invoicing earlier, but it requires sign-off from our finance approver.

I've attached the draft PO they generated (ACME_PO_12345.pdf). It shows expected dates but is not final. If Redwood can bill on the preliminary PO and we confirm final PO within 30 days, that would speed things up.

I'll push procurement to aim for Aug 16–18 and copy their PO mailbox.

Best,
Sarah Liu
Head of Platform Partnerships
ACME Corp

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, PO Team <po_processing@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cutover: PO receipt windows impacting recognized bookings

Sarah — thank you for the quick follow. This is helpful context.

From a Redwood revenue recognition / booking standpoint, we need either:
- a final PO and invoice issued on or before Aug 20 to include revenue in Q3 close; OR
- a signed PO before Aug 20 plus an explicit written request from ACME for Redwood to invoice against the preliminary PO with final PO to follow within 30 days.

Marissa / Karthik — please do the following:
- Marissa: update the HubSpot commit for deal_1427-ACME to "Commit - At Risk" if we don't receive the final PO by EOD Aug 18. Include a note referencing this thread and the expected invoice date.
- Karthik: if ACME supplies an intent/prelminary PO, confirm with David whether Finance will accept it as sufficient to invoice (David — see attached proposed checklist and cutoff calendar).

David, can you confirm whether Finance will accept invoicing on a prelim PO with final PO within 30 days? If yes, what documentation do we need on file (email confirmations, CFO sign-off, legal language)?

I'm adding a tentative calendar item for the cutoff window (cutoff_calendar.ics) so stakeholders can see the target dates.

Thanks — I want to make sure forecasting is clean for the board deck next week.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cutover: PO receipt windows impacting recognized bookings

+1 on Grace's plan. I'll update the HubSpot stage and add a comment to the opportunity with the expected PO date (Aug 16–18). If ACME provides a preliminary PO, I'll mark the record "Prelim PO Received" and attach the PDF.

David — can you confirm a two-business-day expedited invoicing route if ACME requests it (i.e., we accept prelim PO, issue invoice within 48 hours once finance confirms the prelim)? If that's feasible we'll request Sarah to get procurement's written intent.

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cutover: PO receipt windows impacting recognized bookings

Confirming Finance stance: we can accept invoicing on a preliminary PO ONLY if we have the following documented BEFORE invoicing:
1) Email from the buyer (CFO or delegated finance approver) explicitly authorizing Redwood to invoice on the preliminary PO with commitment to provide final PO within 30 days.
2) A copy of the preliminary PO that shows the PO number and expected dates (ACME_PO_12345.pdf qualifies).
3) Legal to confirm contract language allows invoicing on an initial PO/intent (I'll loop legal if needed).

If those three items are present, Treasury will process the invoice and we can tag revenue to the month in which the invoice date falls (subject to our GL cutoff of Aug 20 for Q3). There is no automatic retroactive recognition without documented agreement — we need the email authorization before creating the invoice.

Actionable next steps:
- Marissa: ask Sarah to get a short email from ACME's finance approver (CFO or delegate) with explicit authorization.
- Karthik: once you have the prelim PO, attach it and flag the HubSpot record.
- Grace: if we can't get the email and prelim PO by EOD Aug 18, move the forecast accordingly.

I've attached a one-pager with required fields for expedited billing (billing_action_items.docx). Happy to hop on a 15m call if we need to triage.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Revenue Accounting
Redwood Inference
